RFC 8050 Section 4.1: "This adds a field to the RIB Entries record to store the Path Identifier when used with the RIB_IPV4_UNICAST_ADDPATH, RIB_IPV4_MULTICAST_ADDPATH, RIB_IPV6_UNICAST_ADDPATH, and RIB_IPV6_MULTICAST_ADDPATH subtypes." Tested: the existing RIB Entries field is redefined for use within the new AFI/SAFI-specific RIB subtypes defined by this document as follows. TestRFC8050AddPathRIBEntryFollowsFigure1 compares WriteRIBEntries output with the literal Figure 1 octets and decodes them under subtypes 8-11; TestRIBRecordAddPathRoundTrip round-trips PathID 1 and 2 under subtype 8; TestRIBRecordRoundTrip (negative) reads no Path Identifier under base subtype 2. Gap: This adds a field to the RIB Entries record to store the Path Identifier. Producer internal/plugins/mrt/dump.go::writeTableDumpV2 builds each mrtfmt.RIBEntry from PeerIndex, OrigTime and Attributes only, because registry.RIBDumpVisitor.OnRoute carries no path id, so under the add-path toggle every entry's field is written as 0 and the route's Path Identifier is not stored. Revert records cover all three tagged units.
